items.title: A lisse constructible sheaf on a connected scheme over the pro-etale site is adic lisse
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file proetale.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a connected scheme X, a Noetherian ring Lambda and an ideal I, every lisse constructible Lambda-sheaf on the pro-etale site of X is adic lisse (statement lines 5845-5851). The proof (proof lines 5853-5871) identifies the reductions with pullbacks of locally constant etale sheaves, restricts to a covering by affine weakly contractible schemes where the sheaf is the completion of a finite module, and concludes by comparing those modules through their reductions and completions. H2: a three-step argument with five inputs, written out in full.
